about.title: How it works
about.sliders: Each slider is a school subject. Set it to your grade from 1 to 10, the Dutch school scale: 6 or more is a pass.
about.floors: The five floors are the levels of education in the Netherlands. After primary school, pupils go to vmbo, havo or vwo, and from there on to:
about.floor.0: work you can start without a diploma; you learn on the job.
about.floor.1: vocational school (mbo) levels 2-3: learn a trade in 2-3 years, often partly at work.
about.floor.2: the highest vocational level, 3-4 years; it can lead on to hbo.
about.floor.3: hogeschool, a university of applied sciences: practical higher education, after havo, vwo or mbo 4.
about.floor.4: universiteit, a research university: the most theory, after vwo (or via hbo).
about.states: Open: your grades are enough. Nearly there (+N): N more points on the sliders would open it. Locked (🔒): still too far for now.
about.goal: Tap a profession and choose ‘This is my goal’: the sliders then mark with ⚑ what your goal needs, and the top of the page shows what is still missing.
about.demo: All numbers are demo data for now: made up for this prototype and approximate, not real admission rules and not advice.
about.privacy: Privacy: the page itself stores nothing and sends nothing. The hosting provider serves the files and sees an ordinary page request, but never your grades or your goal: they live in the address after the #, and that part is not sent.

doors.about.doors: Each door is a profession. The doors stand together by kind of work, and in alphabetical order inside a group. There is no top and no bottom.
doors.about.states: Open: your grades are enough. Almost open: one more point in one subject opens the door, and the door says which subject. Not open yet: it needs more points. The top of the page shows the step that opens the most doors right now.
